description: MND 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：mnd 表型/刺激提取；mnd 质控汇总；mnd 数据校验；FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）；fMRIPrep 本地环境执行；混杂回归与去趋势；ROI 时间序列与功能连接；任务态一级 GLM；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: mnd 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge MND phenotype data. Reads MND phenotype files (diagnosis, clinical measures) and produces a merged phenotype table aligned with imaging subject list。 Inputs: phenotype_files: 文件路径清单（每行一项） (file); imaging_ids: Text file with imaging subject IDs to filter (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: mnd 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries for MND processing. Clinical-specific: tracks diagnosis group and applies appropriate QC criteria。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: mnd 数据校验
method_refs.role: Validate MND BIDS structure and generate compliance report. Checks directory structure, modality completeness, and participant group labeling。 Inputs: input: Path to MND BIDS directory (directory). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）

execution_resolution.reason: 选择原文委托的具体结构处理入口；不同流程分别列出，按用户所需范围执行。

method_refs.role: Invoke the existing FSL fsl_anat workflow on a T1-weighted image and retain its structural.anat directory, including the bias-corrected brain image。 Inputs: input: T1w NIfTI (file). Registered outputs: results/structural.anat/T1_biascorr_brain.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fsl-anat.

method_refs.label: fMRIPrep 本地环境执行
method_refs.default_reason: 配置 LOCALFLOW_FMRIPREP_EXECUTABLE 后可直接运行，不向后端开放 Docker socket。

execution_resolution.reason: 完整预处理需要 fMRIPrep 环境；已有预处理 BOLD 可直接选择所需的原去噪、连接或任务 GLM。

method_refs.role: 通过 NeuroClaw 式可执行环境路径运行单个受试者的 fMRIPrep；环境未配置时保留为明确的禁用选项。
